mismatched_log_duration_policy: exclude when raw duraton differs from naive stop-start; DST-like ambiguity
frequency_unit: distinct airing after union of same-user same-channel viewing fragments
truth_rule: top5 qualifying programme counts DESC, programme ID ASC on ties
boundary_policy: clip observed seconds to each window; preserve full airing duration denominator
metadata_policy: last nonempty field from airings starting strictly before training cutoff
schedule_conflict_policy: remove both conflicting labelled airings from interaction join; availability candidates keep any labelled airing
future_features: Baseline prepare/evaluate uses target IDs only; V4 explicitly uses structural target timetable exposure per configs/v4.json, never future viewing/content metadata.
